rule: A cause group lists every published category label, in each register, that contains a word starting with one of the group’s stems (case-insensitive). The Wave 1b English stems apply to every label; a language stem applies only to labels published in that language. Matching uses label text only. The registers define their categories differently, so a group is a reading aid, not an equivalence or an official crosswalk. A label can fall in more than one group or in none.
